# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P21](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0021)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P21](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0021)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy Andrews is a big, fat, stolid youth with a round, freckled, expressionless face and a perpetual grin. He has a broad countenance and is known to be very fat.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P35](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0035), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P43](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0043), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)_

## Personality

Billy is extremely shy, quiet, and stolid, lacking conversational gifts. Despite his painful lack of speech, he is known as a good, hard-working, and dependable fellow with a good-natured, easily pleased disposition. He enjoys attending local social gatherings and admiring others silently.

_Sources: [v1 c25 P47](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0047), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)_

## Goals

- To marry and establish a home on the upper Andrews farm  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## History

Billy Andrews grew up in Avonlea as a member of the Andrews family. He attended local school gatherings and concerts, often admiring Anne Shirley from afar with silent devotion. Due to his extreme shyness, he enlisted his sister Jane to propose marriage to Anne on his behalf after his father granted him the upper farm in his own name. Following Anne's prompt rejection of the proposal, Billy suffered no lasting heartbreak and instead married Nettie Blewett, with whom he 'appeared out' at the Avonlea church shortly thereafter.

_Sources: [v1 c25 P47](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0047), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c1 P0](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0000), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022)_
